name: Periyar

source.name: Sivagiri Hills, near the Tamil Nadu border

did_you_know: Kerala's longest river by discharge, the Periyar is dubbed the 'Lifeline of Kerala' and supplies about a quarter of the state's industry along its lower course near Kochi.

The Mullaperiyar Dam, one of the oldest masonry dams in India, diverts part of the river eastward through a tunnel into Tamil Nadu's Vaigai basin — a century-old arrangement that remains a live interstate legal dispute.
Its upper course runs through Periyar Tiger Reserve, where the dammed Periyar Lake is a major wildlife-viewing destination.
